title: The Vanished Golden Mic
scene: Between 7:15 and 7:35 PM, the vintage golden microphone vanished from Studio A. The lounge has a keycard log and a glass wall to the hall.

suspects.name: Diana Alcott
suspects.testimony: I edited audio clips in the lounge from 7:10 to 7:40 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The lounge keycard log and Carmen's view through the glass confirm Diana was alone.

suspects.name: Trevor Gaines
suspects.testimony: I was in the lounge with Diana from 7:10 to 7:40 PM, helping her trim the interview clips.
suspects.contradiction: Carmen saw Diana alone in the lounge, and the golden mic was hidden in Trevor's backpack.

suspects.name: Carmen Solano
suspects.testimony: I coiled cables facing the glass lounge wall from 7:10 to 7:40 PM; only Diana was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The evening security guard chatted with Carmen outside the lounge from 7:10 to 7:40 PM.

suspects.name: Philip Lawson
suspects.testimony: I stacked vinyl sleeves right outside Studio A from 7:15 to 7:35 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The hallway webcam shows Philip stacking vinyl sleeves outside Studio A from 7:15 to 7:35 PM.
